name: How can I prevent insect damage in my log home?
description: Regular inspections, maintaining log finish, addressing moisture, and borate treatments prevent insect damage.

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent insect damage in my log home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing insect damage involves regular inspections, maintaining a proper finish on your logs, and addressing any moisture issues promptly. Applying borate treatments can offer long-term protection against wood-boring insects. Keep vegetation trimmed away from the cabin to reduce access for pests.
